quantity: mean streamwise velocity U/Uref and signed lower-wall Cf
pairing: exact experimental station and y/H; no extrapolation
reattachment_rule: last negative-to-positive Cf crossing in 1<x/H<12; multiple crossings are reported
cf_rule: Cf=-2*wallShearStress_x/Uref^2; OpenFOAM kinematic traction into fluid, downstream lower wall
interpretation: project development screening thresholds, not a published certification standard
qualification_blockers: the profile file supplies no uncertainty for mean U
ww and inlet dissipation are not measured: ww=vv and mixing length 0.07*1.5H are assumptions
near-wall inlet endpoints and zero mean transverse inflow are assumptions
a mesh series and an inlet-turbulence sensitivity study must be assessed separately
no scalar concentration measurements and no native street-canyon validation
